description: This file implements the Cuttlefish configuration management, including loading, saving, and accessing various configuration parameters and paths for the Cuttlefish Android virtualization environment.

classes.name: ConfigFragment
classes.description: A class representing a configuration fragment that can be loaded and serialized within the Cuttlefish configuration system.

classes.name: CuttlefishConfig
classes.description: Main class managing the configuration parameters for Cuttlefish, including loading from files, accessing paths, and managing instance-specific settings.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a specified file.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration data to a specified file.

methods.name: root_dir
methods.description: Returns the root directory of the configuration.

methods.name: set_root_dir
methods.description: Sets the root directory of the configuration.

methods.name: set_ap_vm_manager
methods.description: Sets the application processor VM manager name.

methods.name: set_secure_hals
